Execute default Scrape action and verify extracted content

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"}}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.interact_async(engine, url, [:scrape])
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.action_results, 0).success)
```
